integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional proof with a separately executable symbolic and finite-order numerical checker; no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The reaction kinetics are a distinct polynomial strong-Allee model, not those in the motivating preprint. Claims about stability concern the uniform state; nonuniform bifurcating equilibria are not shown attracting. The strict biomass losses hold locally at simple isolated thresholds, not globally across all patterned equilibria. Classical bifurcation and modal techniques are prior art; independent literature-priority review is absent.
title: Sharp disconnected network Turing windows with strict local prey and predator biomass loss
